env.bush.label: bushes and shrubs that break in one go

env.cliff.label: cliffs, pillars and arches: rock standing over 20 m above ground or over 30 m across

env.debris.label: scattered non-plant props: statues, grave stones, frozen bodies, pots, ruin fragments, ice sheets

env.flower.label: flowers: pickable ones and instanced ones

env.grass.label: grass and ground cover the clutter system instances

env.log_stump.label: stumps, felled logs and their halves, old fallen logs

env.mineable.label: ore deposits and mineable remains: copper, tin, silver, iron (mud piles, giant remains), obsidian

env.pickable.label: pickables: stones, flint, branches, mushrooms, seeds, berry bushes

env.rock_large.label: big rocks 5 to 30 m across, mostly buried, that break into dozens of hit areas

env.rock_small.label: boulders under 5 m that break in one go or into a few pieces

env.tree_blackforest.label: Black Forest and Mountain conifers: fir and pine

env.tree_deepnorth.label: Deep North snow firs and pines

env.tree_small.label: saplings and small trees that break in one go (Destructible of type Tree)

env.tree_swamp.label: Swamp trees: the ancient tree and its giant form

location.altar.label: boss altars, rune stones, stone circles, dolmens and henges

location.camp.label: camps, huts, cabins, farms and villages (villages and camps are built from rooms at runtime)

location.dungeon_entrance.label: entrances with an interior 5000 m up: crypts, caves, the Dvergr town and boss halls

location.dungeon_room.label: dungeon rooms (Room prefabs) the DungeonGenerator strings together, every theme

location.natural.label: natural sites: tar pits, fire holes, nests, the infested tree, giants' remains, sulfur arch

location.ruin.label: ruined stone houses, towers, wells, graves, wrecks and the charred ruins

location.structure.label: standing structures: Dvergr towers, lighthouse, harbour, viaducts, statues, waymarkers

terrain.looks: grey faceted rock, height in alpha (cliff)
flat orange placeholder: the snow slot, drawn by the shader
dark brown leaf litter, alpha-masked (Black Forest floor)
